title: Liya Kedar: statement plus one labelled strip of five projects
note: The whole home fits one screen: a two-line uppercase statement with key words underlined ('TYPOGRAPHY, COLOR, … TEXTURES'), then five tall image columns edge to edge, each captioned underneath with name in caps, discipline (Magazine, Product Design, Title Sequence…) and a one-line description. The caption of the active column turns lilac. Worth reusing: every image is labelled with what it is, so you never wonder what you're looking at.
